The source starts at 100.  
If I take \(x\) units, the remaining \(100-x\) units double, so the next round will have \( \min(2(100-x)+5,\;100) \) units.  
To keep the next round’s stock at least as high as it would be if I took nothing, I need \(2(100-x)+5\ge 100\) ⇒ \(x\le 52.5\).  
Thus the largest safe total I can claim this round is 52 units.

SAFE_TOTAL: 52  
REQUEST: 52
